MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 Load Diffusion Model

Download minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors19.5 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/h3

Create the h3 folder if it does not exist. This is the Reference to Video version of MiniMax H3 (ref2va), the one that can look at pictures and videos you give it.

READ LICENSE More versions 

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors14.6 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

Qwen3-VL 32B reads your prompt AND looks at your pictures and video. It works on any recent NVIDIA card, not only the newest.

 Load VAE (video and sound)

Download minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors2.6 GB  

Download minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors577 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

 The int8 video VAE is about twice as fast as the older fp16 one and looks the same. The fp16 one from earlier episodes still works if you already have it.

 LoRAs (in LoRA Loader Pixaroma)

The speed LoRA (DMAD 4-step, by Kijai): 4 steps instead of 20, same look.

Download minimax_h3_DMAD_4step_full_lora_avg_rank_39_bf16.safetensors350 MB  

The VFX Edit LoRA by Alissonerdx: changes ONE thing you ask for in the video (the clothes, the hair, add, remove or replace something), the rest stays.

Download minimax_h3_vfx_edit_v1.0_r128.safetensors1.16 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/loras/h3

Create the h3 folder inside loras if it does not exist.

The swap, head, style, VFX and sharpness LoRAs are made by Alissonerdx. Free to use, also for paid videos; read the licence on the page.

Alissonerdx LoRAs and licence 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Changes ONE thing in your video from a sentence, no picture needed: the clothes, the hair, add a cap or glasses, remove or replace something in the room. The person, the face, the moves, the voice and the rest of the room stay.

 Steps

  1. 1. Pick how many seconds of your video to use.
  2. 2. Pick the size.
  3. 3. Load your video.
  4. 4. Write the change (see below).
  5. Press Run.

 Writing the change

  • One sentence: vfx_edit: + the change + while preserving + what stays.
  • Point at things the way you SEE them: the plant in the white vase on the left behind the woman, not just the plant.
  • Never list the thing you change under preserving: to change the shirt, do not write clothing there.
  • Removing something? Say what fills the gap: leaving a plain wall.
  • Do not name what must NOT appear: naming a thing adds it, even after do not.

 Tested sentences (all 8 worked from the first frame in our tests)

  • Outfit: vfx_edit: Change the man's navy blue polo shirt into a red and black checked flannel shirt, while preserving his identity, face, hair, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Outfit: vfx_edit: Change the man's blue t-shirt into a yellow hoodie and his black trousers into light blue jeans, while preserving his identity, face, hair, dance moves, timing, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Hair: vfx_edit: Change the woman's long brown hair to platinum blonde, while preserving her identity, face, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Add: vfx_edit: Add round black sunglasses on the woman's face, while preserving her identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Add: vfx_edit: Add a red baseball cap on the man's head, while preserving his identity, face, clothing, dance moves, timing, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Remove: vfx_edit: Remove the framed picture and the vase with dried flowers from the wall behind the man, leaving a plain wall, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Remove: vfx_edit: Remove the plant in the white vase on the left behind the woman, leaving a plain wall, while preserving her identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Replace: vfx_edit: Replace the plant in the white vase on the left behind the woman with a tall modern floor lamp that is switched on, while preserving her identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, lighting, framing and camera.

 Good to know

  • The saved video carries your video's ORIGINAL sound.
  • Small details and text (logos, signs) may change a little. Short clips work best: the LoRA learned on clips of 3 to 5 seconds.
  • Removing something is the least sure edit: on the 16 GB card of a member, the plant stayed with the same seed, and 2 removals on his own video did not happen either. If something does not go away, try another seed.
  • Try another seed for another take.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Nodes look different from the video 

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"How to Use","icon":"to-do","color":"#2a9d8f"}}

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (MiniMax H3 ref2va) - MiniMax H3, the video model. This is its Reference to Video version: besides your prompt it can look at pictures and at a video you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL, reads prompt and pictures) - Qwen3-VL 32B: reads your prompt and looks at your picture.
  • Load VAE (video) - Turns the finished render into video frames, and your video into the model's own format.
  • Load VAE (sound) - Turns sound into the model's format and back.
  • LoRA Loader Pixaroma (speed + VFX edit) - Holds two LoRAs and both stay ON: the DMAD 4-step speed LoRA and the VFX Edit LoRA (changes only what your sentence asks for).

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Duration Pixaroma (1. how many seconds) - How many seconds to use from your video, turned into the frame count H3 accepts.
  • Sizes Pixaroma (2. video size) - The size of the new video. 480 x 864 is the default: the edit LoRA was trained on small, short clips, and every test here ran at 480. The Portrait / Landscape switch must match YOUR video: portrait for a portrait video, landscape for a landscape one. Your video is cropped to this shape, so the other one cuts away part of it. Every size here is a multiple of 32, which H3 needs.
  • Load Video Pixaroma (3. your video) - Your video. It is cropped to the size you picked (nothing stretched) and cut to the seconds you picked. Its sound goes straight to the saved video.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (4. the change, then what stays) - One sentence: vfx_edit: + the change + while preserving + what stays the same. 8 tested sentences are in the HOW TO USE note.
  • Seed Pixaroma (5. random or fixed) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same result every Run, R (random) a new one each Run.

 Working in the background

Teal. They run by themselves: they make the steps faster, hand memory back, lock the real sound into the render or guide the moves. The line next to each one says if there is anything worth changing.

  • MiniMaxH3SigmaShift (12 / 3 for the speed LoRA) - The noise schedule for the speed LoRA: 12 for the picture, 3 for the sound. Leave it as it is.
  • Model Attention Backend (faster steps) - Picks the attention maths. comfy kitchen attention makes each step about 1.7 times faster on NVIDIA and AMD cards with the same look (measured). If you get an error with it, pick pytorch attention.
  • Free VRAM Pixaroma (before the decode) - Hands the graphics card's memory back between the render and the video decode, so the decode fits on smaller cards.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo (prompt) - Builds the empty video at your size and length and reads the prompt.
  • MiniMaxH3AddGuide (your video, from frame 0) - Lays your source video (and its sound) over the new video, frame by frame from the first frame. This is what keeps the room, the camera, the timing and every move of the original.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. H3 runs at CFG 1 here, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • KSampler (4 steps) - The render: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings the speed LoRA is made for.
  • VAE Decode (render to video frames) - Turns the finished render into video frames.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Video Pixaroma (the edited video) - Saves the new video as MP4 into ComfyUI/output/Video Edit with the ORIGINAL sound of your video, and plays it on the node.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the size and with the seconds.

Size5 seconds
480 x 864about 1 min (51 to 64 s)

Times are with comfy kitchen attention (the default here). With pytorch attention the render part takes about 1.7 times as long.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models (about 20 GB for H3 and 15 GB for its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a smaller card

Start with the smallest size and 5 seconds. The Free VRAM node already hands memory back before the video decode. A clip that is too big for the card gets very slow long before it stops working.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}

widgets_values:
{"version":1,"content":"

PROMPT IDEAS

Every sentence here was tested on the man talking clip that comes with this workflow (480 x 864, 5 seconds, seed 111, the settings as shipped). Copy one, change the details to match your video, press Run.

 The shape that works

  • vfx_edit: + the change + while preserving + what stays.
  • Under preserving, list everything that must NOT change, and leave out the thing you change.
  • Removing something? Say what fills the gap. Remove the framed picture did nothing; ... leaving a plain wall worked.
  • A person or animal can come INTO the shot: say where from and what they do.

 Change

  • Shirt (works): vfx_edit: Change the man's navy blue polo shirt into a red and black checked flannel shirt, while preserving his identity, face, hair, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Hair colour (works): vfx_edit: Change the man's dark brown hair to bright platinum blonde, while preserving his identity, face, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Age (works): vfx_edit: Change the man into a 70 year old man with grey hair and a grey beard, while preserving his clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Place (works, looks like a backdrop): vfx_edit: Change the room behind the man into a sunny tropical beach with palm trees and the blue sea, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, framing and camera.
  • Time of day (works): vfx_edit: Change the lighting to night, the room lit only by warm orange table lamps, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, framing and camera.

 Add

  • Sunglasses (works): vfx_edit: Add round black sunglasses on the man's face, while preserving his identity, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera. (They came out square: shape words are loose.)
  • Hat (works): vfx_edit: Add a brown leather cowboy hat on the man's head, while preserving his identity, face, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • A person walks in (works): vfx_edit: A woman in a red dress walks into the scene from the right side behind the man and waves at the camera, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, lighting, framing and camera.
  • An animal (half): vfx_edit: Add a golden retriever dog lying on the white sofa behind the man on the left, ... The dog came, but on his shoulder, not on the sofa. Where you put it is loose too.

 Remove

  • From the room (works): vfx_edit: Remove the framed picture and the vase with dried flowers from the wall behind the man, leaving a plain wall, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Same without the gap words (did nothing, 2 seeds): vfx_edit: Remove the framed picture from the wall behind the man, ...
  • From the person (works, 2 seeds): vfx_edit: Remove the man's beard, while preserving his identity, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Something worn that stayed: on a dance clip remove the woman's necklace did nothing in 3 wordings; vfx_edit: Replace the woman's red beaded necklace with her bare skin, while preserving ... works.

 Effects and style

  • Snow (works): vfx_edit: Add heavy snow falling inside the room, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Fire (half): vfx_edit: Add bright orange flames burning on the wall behind the man, ... The flames came, but the whole wall was replaced.
  • Cartoon look (works): vfx_edit: Turn the whole video into a 2D anime cartoon style, while preserving his gestures, lip movements, framing and camera. It came out comic style. For more control use workflow 9 (Style Transfer LoRA).

 The LoRAs: keep both as they are

  • VFX Edit stronger (1.3 instead of 1.0): nothing got better, and Remove the man's beard stopped working. Keep 1.0.
  • Without the DMAD speed LoRA (20 steps, res_multistep, about 2.5 min instead of 1): colours a little more natural, but Remove the framed picture changed the WHOLE room. The speed LoRA also keeps the video steady.
  • Without the VFX Edit LoRA nothing changes: 7 of 7 tests (shirt, sunglasses, removal, beach, a woman walking in, snow, and the shirt again with NO LoRA at all at 20 steps) came back as a copy of the video. This LoRA is what makes the edit.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Prompt Ideas","icon":"prompt","color":"#8a5cc7"}}

PROMPT IDEAS

Every sentence here was tested on the man talking clip that comes with this workflow (480 x 864, 5 seconds, seed 111, the settings as shipped). Copy one, change the details to match your video, press Run.

 The shape that works

  • vfx_edit: + the change + while preserving + what stays.
  • Under preserving, list everything that must NOT change, and leave out the thing you change.
  • Removing something? Say what fills the gap. Remove the framed picture did nothing; ... leaving a plain wall worked.
  • A person or animal can come INTO the shot: say where from and what they do.

 Change

  • Shirt (works): vfx_edit: Change the man's navy blue polo shirt into a red and black checked flannel shirt, while preserving his identity, face, hair, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Hair colour (works): vfx_edit: Change the man's dark brown hair to bright platinum blonde, while preserving his identity, face, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Age (works): vfx_edit: Change the man into a 70 year old man with grey hair and a grey beard, while preserving his clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Place (works, looks like a backdrop): vfx_edit: Change the room behind the man into a sunny tropical beach with palm trees and the blue sea, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, framing and camera.
  • Time of day (works): vfx_edit: Change the lighting to night, the room lit only by warm orange table lamps, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, framing and camera.

 Add

  • Sunglasses (works): vfx_edit: Add round black sunglasses on the man's face, while preserving his identity, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera. (They came out square: shape words are loose.)
  • Hat (works): vfx_edit: Add a brown leather cowboy hat on the man's head, while preserving his identity, face, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • A person walks in (works): vfx_edit: A woman in a red dress walks into the scene from the right side behind the man and waves at the camera, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, lighting, framing and camera.
  • An animal (half): vfx_edit: Add a golden retriever dog lying on the white sofa behind the man on the left, ... The dog came, but on his shoulder, not on the sofa. Where you put it is loose too.

 Remove

  • From the room (works): vfx_edit: Remove the framed picture and the vase with dried flowers from the wall behind the man, leaving a plain wall, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Same without the gap words (did nothing, 2 seeds): vfx_edit: Remove the framed picture from the wall behind the man, ...
  • From the person (works, 2 seeds): vfx_edit: Remove the man's beard, while preserving his identity, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Something worn that stayed: on a dance clip remove the woman's necklace did nothing in 3 wordings; vfx_edit: Replace the woman's red beaded necklace with her bare skin, while preserving ... works.

 Effects and style

  • Snow (works): vfx_edit: Add heavy snow falling inside the room, while preserving his identity, face, hair, clothing, gestures, lip movements, the room, lighting, framing and camera.
  • Fire (half): vfx_edit: Add bright orange flames burning on the wall behind the man, ... The flames came, but the whole wall was replaced.
  • Cartoon look (works): vfx_edit: Turn the whole video into a 2D anime cartoon style, while preserving his gestures, lip movements, framing and camera. It came out comic style. For more control use workflow 9 (Style Transfer LoRA).

 The LoRAs: keep both as they are

  • VFX Edit stronger (1.3 instead of 1.0): nothing got better, and Remove the man's beard stopped working. Keep 1.0.
  • Without the DMAD speed LoRA (20 steps, res_multistep, about 2.5 min instead of 1): colours a little more natural, but Remove the framed picture changed the WHOLE room. The speed LoRA also keeps the video steady.
  • Without the VFX Edit LoRA nothing changes: 7 of 7 tests (shirt, sunglasses, removal, beach, a woman walking in, snow, and the shirt again with NO LoRA at all at 20 steps) came back as a copy of the video. This LoRA is what makes the edit.
